name: Slabs source is copied byte-for-byte and audited from the real terrain shader
Exportable albedo retains the original sRGB-mask → linear colour mix at every source texel
All six surface choices are reusable standard materials; Slabs keeps the source PBR and tiling
Path width, upward faces and real collider are rebuilt after curve/control edits
Concave plaza supports genuine holes without cutting its underlying terrain
Moving, rotating and resizing surfaces preserve world tile density and material identity
Terrain-following paths and plazas conform between control points with a consistent offset
Serialized surfaces retain editable definitions and regenerate the same collidable geometry
Invalid crossing polygons, overlapping holes and duplicate path points fail without mutating a valid surface
Crossing path runs are unioned into one physical sheet rather than stacked slabs
The original car suspension drives across an actual generated pedestrian path
